name: Meeting Time Planner
summary: Plan a meeting across multiple timezones with work-hour hints — locally in your browser.
description: Set a host start time, duration, and participant timezones. See local start/end for everyone, flag who is outside a simple work-hour window, and jump to suggested slots on the same day where more people overlap. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: What do work hours mean?
faqs.answer: A simple local hour range (default 9–17) used to hint whether the meeting sits inside typical daytime for each participant. It is not calendar-aware.

faqs.question: How do suggestions work?
faqs.answer: On the host’s selected calendar day, the planner samples start times and ranks slots by how many participants fall inside the work-hour window.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Planning runs entirely in your browser.
